[page 1]
DATA RETENTION STANDARD
Version 3.2
Effective date: 1 March 2026
1 Purpose
This standard sets how long records are kept.
[page 2]
2 Retention Periods
Customer correspondence is kept for 7 years after the account closes.
System logs are kept for 90 days.
Audit logs are kept for 2 years.
[page 3]
